assets.name: diagnose-before-upgrading
assets.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished educational website illustration matching the supplied reference image's ivory background, deep teal headings, orange accents, softly shaded document icons and explanatory arrows. Reference is style only, create entirely new content. Landscape 3:2, crisp legible large typography, generous spacing, limited exact labels, no logos, no em dashes. Main title: "FIND WHAT FAILED BEFORE CHANGING THE MODEL". Opening diagnostic infographic. Left: industrial pump bearing, old inspection recommendation, fresh repair record disconnected from agent. Label 'Bearing replaced yesterday' and 'Agent recommends replacement'. Right: four clear diagnostic branches with icons: 'Task unclear? Clarify the instruction'; 'Evidence missing? Repair retrieval'; 'Action failed? Check the tool'; 'Still fails? Compare models'. A bottom small evaluation strip reads 'Test the repair on more cases'. Show causal investigation, not automatic promise. No imaginary numeric results.

Two parallel test lanes of the same pump maintenance task and same model: top 'Original setup' with missing repair record, output 'Repeat inspection'; bottom 'Correct evidence supplied' with dated repair document, output 'Check post-repair readings'. assets.name: model-evidence-handoff
assets.prompt: Use case: infographic-diagram. Create a polished educational website illustration matching the supplied reference image's ivory background, deep teal headings, orange accents, softly shaded document icons and explanatory arrows. Reference is style only, create entirely new content. Landscape 3:2, crisp legible large typography, generous spacing, limited exact labels, no logos, no em dashes. Main title: "KEEP THE EVIDENCE THROUGH EVERY MODEL". Two comparison rows, quarry camera illustrative detection. Upper amber row 'Weak handoff': image with uncertain event -> small card 'Possible obstruction' -> confident text 'Confirmed obstruction' with warning icon 'Uncertainty lost'. Lower teal row 'Traceable handoff': original image -> evidence card with 'Source', 'Time', 'Model version', 'Limits', 'Confidence' -> next-check decision 'Inspect or request more evidence'. At bottom output tied by dotted line to original image, caption 'Keep the observation separate from the conclusion'. Avoid fabricated confidence scores.
